gaps.text:
CORE GAPS — drawn here, not in core yet (mirror of docs/web/CORE-GAPS.md · audited 2026-10-11)
✓ = landed on main. Default deployment runs access "legacy": operator data is protected mode only.

Spectrum
✓ FFT stream (spectrum WS channel, per-client 0.5–25 Hz, 128–2048 bins)
• Real zoom (higher-res FFT of the viewed slice; designed on main, not built), FFT size to 16384, averaging
• Waterfall backfill on subscribe
• Low-latency tuner control over WebSocket (drag-to-pan)
• One regional band plan for display: bands, default mode/bw/step, named channels (ch 16, pmr 3, acars…)

Tuner
• Capabilities: gain table in dB, sample-rate presets, tuning range, which controls apply
• DC removal, IQ correction, IQ swap (display masks exist, no sample correction)

Audio
• One WebSocket audio stream, analog + decoded voice auto-routed, 48 kHz, latency
• Live level + squelch state over WS at meter rate (REST only today)
• Auto / noise squelch; AGC modes, noise reduction, blanker, notch, CW BFO, DSB
• Live analog recording (scanner analog recorder exists, disabled)
• Analog vs digital per transmission on shared channels
• CTCSS / DCS detection on live audio + tone squelch (saved freqs store a tone; scanner has ctcssHz)
• DTMF on the tuned channel

Data and Activity
✓ Saved frequencies in core, shared (operator data; protected mode only)
• Operator settings synced: only 4 preferences + 4 command kinds today; need columns, pinned searches, full palette frecency
• Auto band map (occupancy + discoveries exist)
• Common decode envelope, live + stored: 8 categories, entity key, position, tone, recording id (helper exists, unmounted)
• Persistent event store: typed filters, full text, time range, paging
• Facet counts; live push with replay from a cursor
• Recording state on every event + global auto-record mode
• Auto-record all audio, retention, playback with seek; analog transmission events
• Digital call metadata: DMR CC, talker alias, error rate; P25 NAC; encryption algorithm
• Message rate history per decoder; transcription (future)

Access
• Browser access: protected runtime landed (pairing, sessions, origins); missing browser onboarding, public bootstrap, TLS
• List signed-in devices

Scanner (S1 on main)
• Search discoveries by protocol, identity, frequency (labels only today)
• Auto-resume time on a paused scan; decoder names in a sweep's impact
• Progress at 2 Hz; scanner WS replay after reconnect
• Link a saved frequency to its discovery
• S2 enabled (parallel trials, Likely, CTCSS, analog recordings); S3 Scan a list
• Band plans for the ruler: Airband, EU 169 / 466 MHz pagers, display groups, default protocols
• ScannerProtocol: ais, acars, vdl2, lora, tones
• Range names, "signals only" jobs, exclusions per range; which decoders are always on

Recordings
• Keep (star) per recording; manual recordings with name, note, trim
• Operator IQ capture of the viewed span + play as source, SigMF (scanner burst captures exist)
• Waveform peaks / IQ thumbnails; search over kept items
• Storage endpoint (kept, auto, other, free, retention, low-space policy)
• Deep links, Opus / WAV download of the trimmed part

Map
• Station location in core, passed to readsb (can ship early)
• Fleet state beyond aircraft: AIS vessels, APRS stations, mesh nodes; mesh links with SNR
• Position history (trails, last-hour replay, per-minute counts)
• Coverage per bearing (24 h); PMTiles extract + glyphs + style
• Positions from ACARS / VDL2 / AIS AtoN; optional aircraft route + military flag

Settings
• Settings store with provenance + live push (scanner settings API is the model)
• One schema with UI hints for core and every decoder, served as JSON Schema
• Decoder options validated + editable at runtime (PATCH is 501); batched apply
• Station identity owned by core (name, location, region, callsign)
• New settings (language, FFT, retention, auto-record mode, IQ limits, map…)
• Decoder log tail; Pi host details; config export / import, update check

Owner to decide
• Labels for talkgroups, radio IDs, capcodes, MMSIs
